steps: Cook rice according to package directions; keep warm until serving.
Peel and finely dice onion; mince garlic; trim and dice zucchini into 1 cm cubes.
Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add onion and garlic; cook for 3 to 4 minutes, until softened and fragrant.
Add diced zucchini; cook for 4 minutes, stirring occasionally, until just tender.
Stir in drained cooked chickpeas, crushed tomatoes, cumin, paprika, and vegetable broth.
Simmer over medium-low heat for 10 to 12 minutes, until sauce thickens slightly.
Serve the skillet over warm rice in shallow bowls.
Makes 4 family portions; store leftovers refrigerated for up to 3 days or freeze for 1 month.
